race.comment: ITALUS (10) handy Wootton Bassett gelding racing well in his first campaign. Saluted here three-back over the 1400m on a heavy (9) surface. Found the 1400m too sharp last start when fourth at Goulburn in a fairly handy race. Capable of a better run today on the home track. Each-way. LIKE LUKEY (2) has a good record at this trip on the backup. Closed off okay when fourth over 1600m at Tamworth in BM82 at latest. Claim helps but will need a bit of luck from the gate. GODWITS (12) found some form at his last two outings and on the quick back-up after running second over 1700m at Carinda. Was a dominant winner over the 2200m at Dubbo two-back. Leading contender. OWN THEM (9) total forgive from the outside gate when he failed to get into the contest with a poor ninth over 2100m at Narrandera. Caught the eye two-back at Goulburn and gets a better set-up for this.
